tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Returns multiplayer games currently available for browser room creation.

tools.name: get_game_options
tools.description: Returns server-supported rules and defaults for one game.

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Returns currently available Play Face to Face games ranked against player count, available time, complexity, and preferences.

tools.name: create_game_room
tools.description: Creates an ephemeral Play Face to Face multiplayer room that friends can join from browsers. The result includes a canonical guest link, a room-scoped host link, public room metadata, and an expiry time. The idempotency key associates retries with one creation intent.

tools.name: get_room_status
tools.description: Returns the public waiting or expiry status of a Play Face to Face room.

tools.name: render_game_room
tools.description: Renders a Play Face to Face room result as an invitation card with the room code, QR invitation, guest link, and host action.

tools.name: record_invite_copied
tools.description: Record that the room card copied a guest invitation. This tool is available only to the room card.
